chunks.arabic_text: وَسَأَلَ زُرَارَةُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ:

translations.en: Zurārah asked Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام:

chunks.arabic_text: عَنِ الْمُحْرِمِ يَقَعُ الذُّبَابُ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ حِينَ يُرِيدُ النَّوْمَ فَيَمْنَعُهُ مِنَ النَّوْمِ أَ يُغَطِّي وَجْهَهُ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَنَامَ

translations.en: about a muhrim upon whose face flies land when he wishes to sleep, preventing him from sleep: may he cover his face when he wants to sleep?

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a muhrim during hajj or 'umrah. It indicates that if flies on the face prevent sleep, covering the face for sleep is permitted.
en.seo_question: Can a muhrim cover his face while sleeping if flies are bothering him?

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of ihram
